title: Archetype record (SiteSpec v2)
description: Closed archetype classification contract for generic SiteSpec v2 (Slice B, #1287). An archetype is a parser/QA prior, NOT a runtime permission and NOT a capability. 'unknown' is a valid result and must not be coerced into a known class. This is a standalone record schema; the SiteSpec v2 document embeds the same shape under the top-level 'archetype' key.

id.description: Closed archetype vocabulary. Unknown enum values are rejected by the semantic contract.

confidence.description: Bounded 0.0..1.0. Below-0 and above-1 values are rejected.

evidence_refs.description: Detection evidence references. May be empty, but must not be treated as factual freshness/evidence authority.
